crossRefs.note: Elisha prayed, and said, “Yahweh, please open his eyes, that he may see.” Yahweh opened the young man’s eyes; and he…
The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
“Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to…
“Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.
So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.
Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says…

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision; but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.
translations.bsb: Only I, Daniel, saw the vision; the men with me did not see it, but a great terror fell upon them, and they ran and hid themselves.
translations.kjv: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide
translations.asv: And I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, and they fled to hide themselves.
